name: FUN_WF_UPLOAD_ERRORS
description: This table contains data related to the errors occurred as part of spreadsheet upload through which approval rules are created.

columns.name: ERROR_ID
columns.description: Primary key and identifier for error message.

columns.name: UPLOAD_ID
columns.description: Foreign key reference identifier to the FUN_WF_RULE_UPLOADS table.

columns.name: ERROR_NUMBER
columns.description: Serial number by which errors are displayed on the UI.

columns.name: RULE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Rule identifier on the spreadsheet or UI against which the error has occurred. If there are any validation failures then the whole configuration set is not stored.

columns.name: DATA_SET_NAME
columns.description: Name of the data set used while creating the approval rule.

columns.name: MESSAGE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Error message description indicating the validation failure that is preventing creation of the rule.

columns.name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Message name in the FND_MESSAGES table to extract the message.

columns.name: TOKEN_NAME_1
columns.description: Name of token 1 that is passed onto a message as a variable for each message.

columns.name: TOKEN_VALUE_1
columns.description: Value of token 1 that is passed onto a message as a variable for each message.

columns.name: TOKEN_NAME_2
columns.description: Name of token 2 that is passed onto a message as a variable for each message.

columns.name: TOKEN_VALUE_2
columns.description: Value of token 2 that is passed onto a message as a variable for each message.

columns.name: TOKEN_NAME_3
columns.description: Name of token 3 that is passed onto a message as a variable for each message.

columns.name: TOKEN_VALUE_3
columns.description: Value of token 3 that is passed onto a message as a variable for each message.

columns.name: TOKEN_NAME_4
columns.description: Name of token 4 that is passed onto a message as a variable for each message.

columns.name: TOKEN_VALUE_4
columns.description: Value of token 4 that is passed onto a message as a variable for each message.

columns.name: TOKEN_NAME_5
columns.description: Name of token 5 that is passed onto a message as a variable for each message.

columns.name: TOKEN_VALUE_5
columns.description: Value of token 5 that is passed onto a message as a variable for each message.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
